verdict.rationale: Together AI is an inference and training platform, and background automations are a fair question for such a platform, but the evidence shows no product feature for configuring automations that run on their own. Asynchronous batch jobs are one-off, user-submitted workloads rather than recurring or triggered automations. Function calling and agent loops are developer building blocks the user must run in their own application, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
